name: SendMessage
description:
Continue a previously spawned agent by sending it a follow-up message. Pass the agent's ID as the `to` field. The agent resumes with full context preserved.

## When to use
- Follow up on a worker whose previous turn is complete and you want to refine direction.
- Take advantage of a loaded context rather than spawning a fresh agent.

## Arguments
- `to` (required) — Agent ID returned by the Agent tool.
- `message` (required) — Self-contained prompt for the agent. Include everything the worker needs; it cannot see your conversation.
- `reply_to` (optional) — Message ID from the agent's transcript if this message is a direct reply to a prior agent message.
- `routing` (optional) — `{provider, model}` pair to move the agent onto before it resumes. Omit it unless the agent must run on a different route: passing the pair it already runs changes nothing and returns a warning. A real switch needs the "Multi-model fork" setting and a user approval.

to.description: Agent ID to route the message to.

message.description: Self-contained follow-up prompt for the agent.

reply_to.description: Optional message ID to quote-reply to.

routing.description: Optional provider+model pair the agent must run on when it resumes. Omit unless a different route is required.
